title: CrossCBR: Cross-view Contrastive Learning for Bundle Recommendation

problem.claim: Bundle recommendation aims to recommend related item bundles that satisfy users' varied needs conveniently.

gap.claim: Existing methods either use a unified view without differentiation or loosely combine separate bundle and item views, overlooking their cooperative association.

narrative_sequence.summary: Bundle recommendation supports users' varied needs through one-stop recommendation of related item bundles.
Recent methods use user-bundle and user-item interactions to represent bundle and item views.
These methods fail to adequately model the cooperative association between the two views' representations.
